parts.name: archives
parts.description: Reading and writing zip, tar, tar.gz and gz with archiveHelper — format detection from bytes, listing, safe extraction into a tree (traversal, link, duplicate, bomb and overlap guards, per-entry verification, skip or fail), nested archives, packing and gzip/gunzip sources, and the archive limits.

parts.name: extending
parts.description: Writing your own FileSource, FileSink, TreeSink, proxy plugin or URL resolver and the contract each must keep; the invariants of the package (pinned connects, the aws-free ./fetch graph, counted limits, drained tar entries, confined paths, redacted logs); and the package's specs, stand-ins and gates.

parts.name: network
parts.description: What the HTTP client may reach — the connect-time network policy, redirects (followed or returned) and sensitive headers, the pinned WHATWG fetch on the ./fetch subpath, the proxy router and the HTTP and SOCKS proxy plugins and their pinning, why the client is node:http over its own socket under Bun, and the Google Drive and Docs resolver.

parts.name: workload
parts.description: Writing files into a Viable ephemeral workload (makeWorkloadSink over writeBinaryFile) and reading them back (makeWorkloadSource over readBinaryFile) — the 12 MiB per-file ceiling, atomic writes, retries, random access over one read, and archives fanned out into a workload.

parts.name: workspaces
parts.description: Scoped temporary workspaces nested by organization/project/purpose, workspaces mirrored to a bucket (put, restore, evict, drop), bucket prefix listing and removal, and the service's workspace config.
